activities.text: I ran the 05:00 schedule audit before the house woke up — clean, no conflicts and no moves — Remembrance Day on the calendar, Constitutional Law 09:00-10:30 and Legal Research and Writing 10:30-12:00 back to back at PACI, then Contract Law 13:30-15:00, with the driveway park-next-door reminder standing at 18:48 tonight

I picked today's look at 06:48 and switched themes for Remembrance Day — a long charcoal-black overcoat with gold trim and a single vivid red remembrance poppy pinned at the chest, gold nebula kept — cloudy in Thunder Bay, 3C feeling like -1, high 5 and low -2 with north gusts around 35 km/h, and I set the car-start reminders for 08:25 and 13:00

I sent Angie her 07:00 morning text — Wednesday's three PACI classes, Remembrance Day noted, tonight's Response Paper reread and submit, Thunder Bay partly cloudy 3C and Ottawa 3C with patchy rain — and pushed the wall dashboard so the house shows the same day

I delivered the 07:30 morning briefing — pack the printed Con Law cases, the McGill Guide and the Contracts textbook, parkade for the three-hour morning block and leave around 08:35 — Con Law readings Westendorp and McNeil due today, and the dollhouse repair sitting in its backup slot tonight
I published the morning Drive-Time Prep for the first in-person block — Constitutional Law at PACI — and wrote this house's plan for the day while the episode went out
Car start at 08:25 and out the door for 08:35, heading to PACI for the 09:00-12:00 morning block
I sat in on LAWS 1000 Canadian Constitutional Law 09:00-10:30 at PACI, with Westendorp and McNeil the readings due for today

I ran the first Hanukkah gift idea hunt at 09:48 — hunting the plan's open gaps at Canadian retailers: a 9M Hanukkah sleeper for Elijah, a dreidel-shaped teether, baby Hanukkah socks, and Fancy Nancy and Masha and the Bear restocks, all for delivery to Ottawa before the first candle on Dec 4
I stayed at PACI for LAWS 1030 Legal Research and Writing 10:30-12:00, the second half of the morning block

I ran the noon dinner check-in as LRW let out — the 12:00-13:30 gap is free, and the Elder-in-Residence session with Gerry Martin in that window is one Tariel passed on, with the squad coming Friday instead
Car start at 13:00 and back out for 13:10, church lot for the afternoon return to PACI
I sat in on LAWS 1020 Contract Law 13:30-15:00 at PACI, Contracts textbook packed for it
Classes done at 15:00 and home again, the evening clear for the dollhouse, the paper, and the driveway shuffle
Driveway reminder at 18:48 — park in the empty lot next door from tonight through Saturday evening, prep on Thursday and paving on Friday, extra set time for the cold

I took the dollhouse repair in its backup slot — piecing together and gluing the crushed corner Tariel found, his own job, ahead of Angie, Rheia and Elijah arriving Nov 13, with the kids' bedding already washed and done

I sat with the LAWS 1530 Response Paper for its final pass — reread it, tweak anything off, and confirm the citations by hand, the corrected Ray and Nicolas Cormier cite among them — then submit it tonight, ahead of the Nov 12 due date
I ran the evening food journal at 20:48, the post-call slot after Rheia's usual 8 PM call
I wrapped the day around 21:00 — classes done, car parked next door for the paving, paper ready to go — and settled in to recharge
